articles.title: PM Narendra Modi receives grand ceremonial welcome in Jakarta
articles.summary: PM Modi received a grand ceremonial welcome upon arriving in Jakarta on Tuesday for his official state visit to Indonesia, with military fighter jets escorting his aircraft.

articles.title: "Steel equivalent to 40 new Eiffel Towers or five Burj Khalifas, cabling could wrap the Earth twice": PM Modi refers to materials used in Rajasthan refinery complex
articles.summary: PM Modi highlighted India's refining infrastructure, noting that a massive refinery complex inaugurated in Rajasthan utilized materials equivalent to 40 Eiffel Towers with cabling long enough to wrap the Earth twice.

articles.title: "I am a great admirer of Narendra Modiji": Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto
articles.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto praised PM Modi at an Indian diaspora event in Jakarta, saying he studied and adopted several of Modi's policies for governance.

articles.title: "Australia-India relationship of great importance": Diaspora voices enthusiasm ahead of PM Modi's Australia visit
articles.summary: Members of the Australia India Society of Victoria expressed enthusiasm over PM Modi's upcoming visit to Australia from July 8-10, with expectations of approximately 30,000-40,000 Indian diaspora members attending community events.

articles.title: Indonesia offers grand welcome to PM Narendra Modi as its fighter jets accompany PM's plane
articles.summary: PM Modi arrived in Jakarta on Monday where Indonesian Air Force fighter jets escorted his aircraft as part of a ceremonial welcome, marking the start of his three-nation tour.
